g_policy.reason: The pop-up is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (no sponsored stories for 30 minutes), declining changes nothing, and 'if the ad fails' gives a path.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored cards, a feature_time reward with no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is reading position in an article, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed or capped. Sponsored cards still show as usual unless the reader earns a window.

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a pop-up over s02 Article, which is rated safe and is not a chat screen. It is not placed in a message list.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is a product_change. The new resource is an ad-light read, tied to the observed core flow f01 (read a story, s01 -> s02).

c2_evidence.reason: The flow says the in-article sponsored card 'sits further down', but the s02 element order places s02.e13 before the body text (s02.e23 onward), so the claim is unsupported. The 'most in the way while deep in an article' rationale rests on that claim.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No paid plan was observed, so there is no subscription benefit to give away, and the reward is time-limited and capped at 2 per day.

c5_moment.reason: The pop-up appears halfway through an article, which interrupts reading. It is not a moment of need (no limit hit, locked item tapped, or finished action) and it is not a persistent surface the reader chose to open.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is granted only once the play is confirmed (unconfirmed play unlocks nothing), and the scroll-position trigger is an app event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Taboola sponsored cards in the home feed (s01.e44) and in articles (s02.e13), the article reader, and the patchy feed-slot fill.

other_concern: Hiding the cards assumes the app can suppress Taboola and direct-sold placements for a window, which was not observed. The s04 'AD' slot and the s05 in-article ad are not covered by the claim. The revenue trade-off is speculation.
